svg.title: Discussion Workflow: Verification and Recovery
svg.desc: Detailed stages for scope, read-only action gating, complete capture, reconciliation, Excel export, readback and source review. Failed checks enter bounded host-model recovery, while suspected mutations stop all browser interaction. Model handoffs restore applicable local checkpoints only.
svg.text: Discussion Workflow: Verification and Recovery
Current host AI owns decisions. Scripts validate captures and workbook cells.
Preflight and checkpoint
Current URLs, requested cohorts, instructions and source IDs.
Resolve ambiguity before opening unrequested cohorts.
Action gate: clearly read-only and permitted?
Apply before every browser action with fresh observations.
Unsafe or
unclear
L3: stop unsafe action
Suspected mutation: stop browser use.
Disclose evidence and uncertainty.
No Canvas undo or automatic reversal.
Yes
Expand, paginate and capture
All roots and reply depths; stable IDs and parent relationships.
Preserve quotes, attachments and evidence; checkpoint each page.
Source coverage and identity verified?
Reconcile roots, all replies, authors, edits and count semantics.
A visible DOM snapshot or unread badge is not proof.
No
Host-model recovery
Preserve error and evidence.
L1: bounded safe retry or local repair.
Verify outcome before resuming.
L2: ask for missing source or decision.
Keep other cohorts' statuses separate.
Source retry: action gate applies
Yes
Prepare and export selected cohorts
New output directory; one workbook per cohort; all reply columns.
Keep raw capture, matrices and row-to-entry audit mappings.
Export failure: local recovery only
Independent readback and final review passed?
Saved cells, exact cohort files, no formulas, visual layout.
Source spot-checks and freshness remain separate gates.
No
Do not deliver as complete
Repair only the failed local stage,
or revisit unresolved source evidence.
Re-run all invalidated checks.
Yes
Handoff: files, totals, evidence and limitations
Complete only if every requested cohort passes all gates.
Otherwise partial/blocked; no automatic grading or upload.
Interruption or model handoff: restore local checkpoints, never Canvas
Read current instructions; verify checkpoint hashes and scope; get a fresh browser observation.
Check source freshness, invalidate dependent outputs, and resume the applicable stage through its gates.
Do not reuse stale selectors, assume memory transferred, or silently switch providers.
These are agent-operated recovery rules, not a claim of automated model rollback or live-test coverage.
No finite error matrix guarantees every future Canvas interface or browser failure.
